title: BPP request envelope (DESIGN.md §14.2): version, op, optional MutationMeta
description: Generic argument-free envelope shape. Every concrete operation has its own closed schema that restates these envelope fields plus that operation's exact argument fields; operation arguments never validate against this generic schema. Mutating operations validate against #/$defs/mutationRequest, which requires meta; reads never carry meta. Instances must pass strict I-JSON acceptance and the §14.9 byte limits before schema validation.

operationId.description: Versioned BPP operation id from the frozen bundle registry (§14.6). The registry, not this pattern, decides membership.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

mutationMeta.description: MutationMeta (§14.2). Required on every mutation; updates additionally supply expected_revision.

mutationRequest.description: Envelope shape for a mutating operation: meta is required (§14.2 — every mutation requires request id and idempotency key).
